instruction: Use the right arm to grab the metal body sauce can and place it by the blue kitchenpot

source.instruction: Use the right arm to grab the metal body sauce can and place it by the blue kitchenpot

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the can, which was at x = +28 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper forward to y=12 cm and lower slightly toward the sauce can.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-1, +35, -3) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +17 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (29, 15, 91) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate gripper roll and yaw to align with the sauce can body and adjust y position.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -3, +0) cm, now 2 cm (horizontal) / +17 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (29, 14, 83) opening 0.83; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift can up to z=93 cm and move back along y toward y=4 cm.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (19, -1, 93) opening 0.85; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower can toward the table to z=88.5 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, -4) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +9 cm (vertical) from the can

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (19, -1, 89) opening 0.84; table z = 74
